verdict.rationale: Training-data privacy is a fair question for an AI voice-assistant platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a training opt-out or any data-use policy. Running the server on your own computer and swapping language models through profiles are adjacent features. They are not a documented guarantee that your data won't be used for training, especially since the 01 can route voice through OpenAI's Realtime API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
